_fixture.kind: HAND-BUILT synthetic paper, not a capture
_fixture.why: All eight committed excerpts under data-provider/fixtures/ are month-denominated, so nothing there exercises the week branch of the unit-carrying timeline fill (E11 Stage 1). The 12-paper corpus survey of 2026-08-18 found week-denominated plans in published papers ("Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1-6)"), so the branch is real and shipping it untested would ship an untested branch.
_fixture.not_evidence_about_the_corpus: This file is evidence about the CODE only. It is hand-built, it was never captured from a paper, and it must never be counted in a corpus census. It lives outside data-provider/fixtures/ for exactly that reason: the parser census tests glob that directory.
_fixture.contains_no_client_data: Neutral phase names, a neutral chart name, no company, no project, no figure. Nothing here needs scrubbing because nothing here came from a client.
_fixture.shape: One horizontal floating-bar <Chart>, the structural predicate chart_timeline_parser.is_timeline selects on: type bar, options.indexAxis y, every dataset value a two-element span. The dataset label and every phase label state weeks, so data unit and label unit agree and no unit_conflict is reported.
